blocks.text: How beautiful God is and the things that He does! If you do not make it in the translation, you will go into the dust of destiny. If you are going to go in the translation, you better get the oil of Pentecost in you, the Holy Spirit. “I don’t see how anybody can look to heaven and say there is no God” (Abraham Lincoln). There is a great God. I won’t be able to talk to you if there is no God; we would all be dead.

Each president beginning with Washington will have to pass the Great One, the Almighty, just like anyone else. His eyes will look at everyone. What a great set of eyes! When He is looking at you, He looks straight at you just like He is looking at everybody. Each president will have to give an account of his work. Paul said everyone will have to give an account (2 Corinthians 5: 11). Emperor Claudius said, “All of us caesars will have to pass before God.”

Each one of the world leaders will have to stand before Him, small and great; no one rich or poor will miss it at the White Throne. He doesn’t need books. God’s mind is a book. He doesn’t need a record. He gets one to let you know that He has one (Revelation 20: 12). He can tell you who you are. He doesn’t need a book. He is the Almighty. He’s got the great galaxy.

Human nature is stealing everything He has put in your soul. Allow the Spirit to stand up. Put down human nature. Human nature is bad; when the flesh and satan get together, they are like twins. Don’t you know you will judge angels? We’ve got a little time left on this earth to make it right. I believe in the translation; we will not all die, we will be gone! You will have one opportunity to do what you can for God. When He says, “Come up, hither,” you cannot say, “Wait, Lord.” You have one opportunity to get it right and work for God. Only what is done for Christ will last.

Salvation was preached to show that the Lord loves the least and the greatest. All will see Him. Every eye will look upon Him. Every tongue shall confess and every knee shall bow to Jesus Christ. The greatest prophets and the twenty-four elders will bow (Revelation 4: 10; 5: 8). What a magnetism that runs from Him to us! When He appears before you it will knock you out as it did Daniel and John. We cannot love the Lord as He loved us. When we see Him, we will feel like we are unworthy. He limited Himself when He appeared to the prophets and apostles.

Each one of us will have to live with family in this life—with all the tests and trials—the flesh and satan may make you think He is too far away when He is so close. I can feel Him right here. God will not forget you. “I cannot forget,” saith the Lord. “I am not man.” “I see you all,” saith the Lord.

God has given us some good presidents to help this nation, but there are some bad ones. This nation (USA) has watched over the world. But things are changing, the lamb will soon speak as a dragon (Revelation 13: 11). Now, this nation is just like all the other nations except for the Christians we have around. While we’ve got a chance, this nation is still open to the devil. Each one of you, pray for the souls, for the harvest of the ones on the highways and hedges. The old dead winter is over; the summer of harvest for the elect is here. Many are falling away. The elect will have the element of fire in them. They will not fall away like the apostates. As we get closer to the coming of the Lord, the word of God will become more powerful and it will be manifested. I want you to prepare yourself to take the word of the Lord, not mine. It won’t be long before you are separated; they will try to get through the door, but it is shut. It won’t be long before people have to make up their mind to receive the Lord or to reject Him and be rejected.

“…This same which is taken up from you to heaven, shall so come in the same manner as you have seen him go into heaven” (Acts 1: 11). “For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first. Then we which are alive shall be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air; and so shall we ever be with the Lord” (1 Thessalonians 4: 16 & 17). You can’t make Acts 1: 11 and 1 Thessalonians 4: 16 &17 a liar. Paul said if an angel tells you anything otherwise, he is a liar. There is a transition period in your life and mine. The ordinary eye will never show it to you. After the Lord had planted the good seed, while the people slept, the wicked one came to plant his own seed the tares. I am going to ask the Lord to keep everyone of you from falling.

Wherever this tape goes, I know that the people are not exactly where they should be as the elect of God. The elect have to unite and when they do, they will be like lightning. He is going to give His fire to His elect that are listening to me tonight. This is the voice of the Lord. Suddenly, some crisis will occur at the end of the age. I pray that God keep everyone of you. Lucifer wants to take you away, but we are going to be united by fire. Suddenly, someone will come out of the grave. Next thing, your finger will glow, your flesh will fall off and white cloth will fall on you. The cloth will be light and majestic. You are going to step into something that cannot be described. We are going into the change in a moment, in a twinkle of an eye.

You get the word out to the people. The Lord is with you. Tell them Jesus is coming soon and that He is already beginning to unite; the invitation will soon be over. The Lord will not fail a soul here tonight. Let drops of fire come on them and let their needs be met. The Lord saith, “I love you.”
